The `resolveSymlink` method only takes `zf` and `ze` as parameters, and `ze` is the `ZipArchiveEntry` that was obtained from the enumeration at line 14.

The value of `tmp1` (which is `getSourceFile()`) is not used in the computation of `tmp8` at line 31. The `tmp8` value depends only on `zf` and `ze`, not on `tmp1`.
